findings.claim_checked: Pre-reg table row: 'Train MFU 15–45 % | 10.7 % | below band — the band was naive'
findings.problem: The pre-registered band was set under a DIFFERENT FLOP model than the measured number. PREREG.md row says 'LoRA train step … 15–45 % (model: ~6·N FLOPs/token fwd+bwd)'; the report/JSON use 4·N (fwd 2N + input-grad 2N, frozen base). Under the pre-registered 6·N model the measured run is 6×7.2417e9×3651.8/989.5e12 = 16.1 % — INSIDE the 15–45 % band. The 'below band' verdict is an artifact of an undisclosed model switch, not a measurement surprise. Direction is self-deflating (it understates, not inflates), and the 4·N model is openly stated in Definitions, but the prereg-vs-measured table never discloses that the band and the number use different FLOP models — which misstates prereg compliance, a selling point of this snapshot.
